# Class fields RFC.Code.RFCClass_rfcTitle=Title RFC.Code.RFCClass_number=Number RFC.Code.RFCClass_category=Category RFC.Code.RFCClass_category_informational=Informational RFC.Code.RFCClass_category_experimental=Experimental RFC.Code.RFCClass_category_bcp=Best current practice RFC.Code.RFCClass_status=Status RFC.Code.RFCClass_status_draft=Draft RFC.Code.RFCClass_status_proposed=Proposed RFC.Code.RFCClass_status_final=Final RFC.Code.RFCClass_status_rejected=Rejected RFC.Code.RFCClass_abstract=Abstract RFC.Code.RFCClass_content=Content RFC.Code.RFCClass_obsoletes=Obsoletes RFC.Code.RFCClass_updates=Updates RFC.Code.RFCClass_additionalAuthors=Additional authors
# Class field hints (shown in edit mode) rfc.class.number.hint=Sequential number of the RFC, proposed automatically when the RFC is created. rfc.class.category.hint=Informational describes a practice or a system, experimental proposes a new way of doing things, best current practice describes rules and procedures that are widely adopted. rfc.class.status.hint=Draft while the RFC is being written, proposed once it is submitted for comments, final once it is accepted, rejected otherwise. rfc.class.abstract.hint=A short plain-text summary of the RFC, shown in the list of RFCs. rfc.class.obsoletes.hint=The earlier RFCs that this one replaces. rfc.class.updates.hint=The earlier RFCs that this one amends without replacing them. rfc.class.additionalAuthors.hint=The authors of the RFC besides the person who created the page.
# Home page rfc.home.title=RFCs rfc.home.description=A Request for Comments (RFC) is a document that describes a practice, a proposal or a piece of information inside your organization, in the spirit of the IETF publications of the same name. rfc.home.create=Create an RFC rfc.home.legacyDataWarning=Pages created with version 1.x of the RFC application were found. They must be migrated before they appear in the list below. rfc.home.legacyDataLink=Open the migration page rfc.home.filters.label=Show rfc.home.filters.all=All RFCs rfc.home.filters.draft=Drafts rfc.home.filters.proposed=Proposed rfc.home.filters.final=Final rfc.home.filters.mine=Mine
# Live Data columns rfc.livetable.number=Number rfc.livetable.doc.title=Title rfc.livetable.doc.creator=Author rfc.livetable.doc.date=Last update rfc.livetable.category=Category rfc.livetable.status=Status rfc.livetable.abstract=Abstract rfc.livetable.obsoletes=Obsoletes rfc.livetable.updates=Updates rfc.livetable._actions=Actions rfc.livetable._actions.edit=Edit rfc.livetable._actions.delete=Delete rfc.livetable.emptyvalue=-
# Sheet rfc.sheet.description=This sheet displays and edits the pages that hold an RFC object. rfc.sheet.noObject=This page has no RFC object, so the RFC sheet cannot display it. rfc.sheet.author=Author rfc.sheet.obsoletedBy=Obsoleted by rfc.sheet.obsoletedWarning=This RFC has been obsoleted by: rfc.sheet.updatedBy=Updated by rfc.sheet.updatedInfo=This RFC has been updated by: rfc.sheet.duplicateNumberWarning=Another RFC has the same number: rfc.sheet.linkLabel=RFC {0,number,#}: {1} rfc.sheet.discussion=Discussion rfc.sheet.comments={0,choice,0#No comments yet|1#1 comment|1<{0} comments}
# Template provider rfc.templateProvider.name=RFC rfc.templateProvider.description=A Request for Comments: numbered, with a category, a status, an abstract and a content, which can obsolete or update earlier RFCs.
# Code space rfc.code.title=Code rfc.code.description=This page holds the technical pages of the RFC application: the class, the sheet, the template and its provider, the translations and the migration tool. Edit them only if you know what you are doing.
# Applications panel rfc.panel.label=RFCs
# Migration from version 1.x rfc.migration.title=RFC data migration rfc.migration.description=Version 1.x of the RFC application stored its data in objects of the RFCCode.RFCClass class. Version 2.0 uses the RFC.Code.RFCClass class. This page converts the existing pages, numbers the RFCs that have no number and removes the pages of version 1.x that are no longer needed. Every step can be run again safely. rfc.migration.accessDenied=Only wiki administrators can run the migration. rfc.migration.invalidToken=The request was not accepted (invalid form token). Please try again. rfc.migration.pages.heading=Pages to migrate rfc.migration.pages.none=No page uses the class of version 1.x. There is nothing to migrate. rfc.migration.pages.migrate=Migrate the objects of these pages rfc.migration.migrated={0} page(s) were migrated. rfc.migration.failed=The following pages could not be migrated: rfc.migration.failed.rightsHint=A page that declares required rights above "script" cannot be saved from this page. Migrate or number it by hand, or lower its declared rights first. rfc.migration.reason.notEditable=you are not allowed to edit it rfc.migration.reason.alreadyMigrated=it already holds an object of the new class rfc.migration.reason.notDeletable=you are not allowed to delete it rfc.migration.saveComment=Migrated to version 2.0 of the RFC application rfc.migration.numbering.heading=RFCs without a number rfc.migration.numbering.none=Every RFC has a number. rfc.migration.numbering.assign=Number these RFCs, oldest first rfc.migration.numbered={0} RFC(s) were numbered. rfc.migration.numbering.failed=The following RFCs could not be numbered: rfc.migration.numberingComment=RFC number assigned by the migration page rfc.migration.cleanup.heading=Pages of version 1.x to remove rfc.migration.cleanup.none=No page of version 1.x remains. There is nothing to remove. rfc.migration.cleanup.pending=Remove these pages only once every page listed above has been migrated. rfc.migration.cleanup.samplePage=Also delete the sample RFC page shipped with version 1.x rfc.migration.cleanup.remove=Remove the pages of version 1.x rfc.migration.cleanedUp=The pages of version 1.x were removed. rfc.migration.cleanup.failed=The following pages could not be removed: rfc.migration.rename.hint=Pages created with version 1.x keep their timestamp-based names. You can rename them from their page menu if you want title-based names.
